project.title: Microbial Community from a Plumbing-Based Bioelectrochemical Sensor
project.description: This project studies the microbial community associated with the electrodes biofilm of a plumbing-based bioelectrochemical sensor. The electrodes biofllms were collected after long-term operations of the sensor and subjected to 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing to characterize the microbial composition and diversity involved.
